calculation.description: Fades 60-day risk-adjusted cross-asset moves only when the 20-day mean cross-sectional volatility dispersion is in the upper 40% of its trailing 252-day history. Signal is lagged one completed session to prevent look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: 60D IC remained positive: 2024 0.382144 (82 dates), 2027-2029 0.137922 (386), 2030 0.492352 (80), 2031-2032 0.135269 (221), 2033 YTD 0.114513 (79). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
validation.lookahead_control: Forward returns are evaluated after the signal date; all inputs are shifted one completed session.
